verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Orama publishes a live llms.txt at docs.orama.com, indexing the docs including Cloud and the MCP Server page. Several evidence items are drawn from a published llms-full.txt corpus at docs.orama.com/llms-full.txt, so agents can be pointed at both an index and a full-text agent-oriented doc dump. Missing for 10: first-party guidance explaining how to use llms.txt or llms-full.txt with agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: A data source identifies a specific set of documents, ideally coming from a single origin.
A project is a set of **data sources** that you want to use for RAG, search, or any other method of retrieval.
